content.short: Liquidswap is the premier AMM DEX on Aptos, featuring high security via the Move language and native staking.
content.description: Liquidswap is the definitive decentralized exchange and automated market maker (AMM) built on the Aptos blockchain by Pontem Network. Leveraging the high security and performance of the Move programming language, the platform offers a robust environment for asset swaps, including standard AMM pools for volatile assets and specialized stable swaps for correlated assets. Liquidswap serves as the primary liquidity hub for the Aptos ecosystem, providing users with sub-second finality and minimal slippage. In addition to its core trading features, the platform supports yield farming and native delegated staking.
